summary: Mythology-driven action RPG series from Iron Lore/THQ Nordic and Grimlore Games, centered on ancient-world loot, mastery combinations, and post-launch expansions.

entries.title: Titan Quest
entries.definitive_edition: Titan Quest Anniversary Edition on Windows with all expansions

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than console/mobile capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with all expansions.

primary.version: Titan Quest Anniversary Edition with Immortal Throne, Ragnarok, Atlantis, and Eternal Embers
primary.why: Windows Anniversary Edition with all expansions is the highest-fidelity and most complete route, combining the base game, Immortal Throne, and the later Ragnarok, Atlantis, and Eternal Embers expansions.
primary.how_to_play: Play Titan Quest Anniversary Edition on Windows with Ragnarok, Atlantis, and Eternal Embers installed; apply modern settings and fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Anniversary Edition includes the original game and Immortal Throne; install Ragnarok, Atlantis, and Eternal Embers for full modern content.

entries.title: Titan Quest II
entries.definitive_edition: No final definitive edition yet; Windows Early Access is the current playable route

emulation.notes: Use native PC Early Access only for current-coverage streams.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output, subject to Early Access updates.

primary.why: Titan Quest II has shipped in Early Access on PC storefronts; Windows is the only current shipped route and the best capture route, but it is not yet a final complete 1.0 release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Early Access build through Steam or Epic only if covering current development; for a definitive archive playthrough, revisit at 1.0.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access status means content, balance, and technical behavior can change.
